name: Regular clean
summary: Weekly, every two weeks or monthly — the whole home kept where you like it.
description: The clean most of our customers keep. The same cleaner arrives on the same day and works through the Regular column of the Clean Facts list: kitchen, bathrooms, floors, dusting and the small resets that make a home feel looked after. Most two-bedroom homes take about three hours.
price_note: Two-bedroom home, every two weeks. Weekly visits are $15 less; larger homes are quoted by room.

name: Deep clean
summary: A first visit, a spring clean or the reset before guests arrive.
description: Everything in a regular clean, plus the places a regular clean leaves alone: baseboards, door frames, light switches, the tops of cupboards, behind the toilet and the build-up on tiles and glass. We recommend one before starting regular visits.
price_note: Two-bedroom home. Homes that have gone longer than three months without a clean may take a second visit.

name: Move-in / move-out
summary: An empty home cleaned to the standard a landlord's checklist expects.
description: Every cupboard, drawer and appliance cleaned inside and out, walls spot-cleaned and floors finished last. We work from your lease or inventory checklist if you send it, and come back free if anything is flagged within 72 hours.
price_note: Two-bedroom home, empty. Oven and fridge interiors are included.

name: Office and studio
summary: Small offices, studios and shops, cleaned before you open or after you close.
description: Desks, kitchens, washrooms and floors for workplaces up to about 3,000 square feet, on a schedule that suits your hours. One named cleaner, one monthly invoice, and a key-holding agreement if you want us to let ourselves in.
price_note: Up to 1,500 sq ft, weekly. Quoted after a free walk-through.
